Select exact IC50 activity rows for the HDAC6 assay CHEMBL1865. Require canonical SMILES and PubMed-indexed documents. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures (inner join), compound_records, docs, activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Filter by assay chembl_id CHEMBL1865, standard_type IC50, and docs.pubmed_id is not null. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Keep all activity rows; do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
